newsitem.title: UK: Italy soccer club Bologna to list in London-paper.
newsitem.headline: Italy soccer club Bologna to list in London-paper.

text.p: Italian Serie A soccer club Bologna plans a flotation on the London stock exchange this autumn, The Times reported on Wednesday.

The report quoted Aldo Monteforte, of investment bank Nomura International, as saying Bologna had selected London over other locations as 16 British clubs are already listed there. Bologna on Tuesday appointed Nomura to manage its flotation.

Rome-based club Lazio are also planning to float in London by the end of the year. A flotation in Italy is problematic becuase most clubs do not meet the disclosure rules applicable on the Milan exchange or requirements for three straight years of profit ahead of flotation.
Bologna were virtually insolvent three years ago before they were rescued by a consortium of local businessmen. The club recently scored a coup by signing former Italian international Roberto Baggio.
